Name: Simple Foliage Trees for SVE
Author: Hatsumomito
Description:
> Description:

This is a simple mod that changes the appearance of the trees in Stardew Valley (SVE) to the Simple Foliage style, with colors similar to those of the base game, as they originally had an earthy tone.

> Installation Instructions:

Unzip the file, then drag and drop it into your mods folder.

Or you can simply replace the SVE trees with these trees by following this path (Only for those who don't want mods taking up "unnecessary" space in their folders): /StardewValley/Mods/Stardew Valley Expanded/[CP] Stardew Valley Expanded/assets/Trees and paste the assets there, replacing the original trees.

> Main Features:

I tried to make it look as much like the Simple Foliage color palette as possible for greater immersion. Please feel free to correct me, as I'm a beginner in pixel art.

I didn't recolor the fruit trees because they look similar to vanilla, but I'm willing to recolor them if there's a lot of demand.

> Known problems: There's a known minor issue that I unfortunately don't know how to fix: the trees aren't spawning in the advanced game. Simply sleep for a day and use the CJB cheats menu to make them grow back.

> Requirements:

You only need Content Patcher. If you want to find the original assets and other cool stuff, go here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45591?tab=description]AhCuteArt's mod[/url] (all retextures are in the earthy recolor).

> Credits:

A big thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/AhCuteArt]AhCuteArt[/url] for the open permits and allowing me to edit and publish their earthy SVE assets in vanilla!
